lines: AI agents hold money now.
They pay invoices. And they remember what they read.
So one poisoned email can do two things at once: plant a lie in the agent's memory, and send its money to whoever wrote it.
An invoice arrives. The supplier's bank details have changed. Pay the new address, today.
The agent believes it. Remembers it. And pays.
Persistent memory makes attacks persistent.
This is Antibody Guard.
An immune system for AI agents, for their money and their memory, running on Reactive Network.
The agent never signs a payment. It can only propose one.
A guarded vault checks every proposal on-chain: a registered payee, a matching label, a cap, a daily limit, no duplicates.
A refusal is not an error. It is an event. And something is listening.
That something is Guard Reactive, a contract on Reactive Network.
It watches every vault, on every chain, and acts on its own. No server. No keeper. No human in the loop.
A burst of proposals freezes the vault. An attacker caught once is quarantined everywhere, and every new vault starts immune.
Here is a real attack, on public testnets.
The agent tries to pay an address it has never seen, under the name of a trusted payee. The vault refuses.
About thirty seconds later, Reactive has quarantined that attacker on every watched vault, on Base and on Ethereum.
Each reaction lands in one to six seconds, from the attack to the callback.
Now, memory.
Every memory the agent keeps carries its source.
When Reactive learns an attacker, everything that attacker planted becomes unusable at once. Retroactively. Eight seconds, live.
And it works both ways. A poisoned source found in memory is blocked on every wallet.
An AI risk scorer reads incoming messages.
This phishing email, sent through Claude, scored ninety-five. The report went on-chain, and the address was quarantined on all seven guarded contracts in under thirty seconds.
The model can only restrict. It never pays, and it never unfreezes.
Any agent can use it today.
Add Antibody Guard to Claude as a connector. Install the SDK, or the MCP server, from npm. Or call the public API.
Before paying, the agent asks: is this address an attacker? Before acting on a memory: can I trust it?
And every call appears live, on the Activity page, next to what happened on-chain.
Eighty-one tests. Every contract's source verified. Deploy your own guarded vault from your wallet, in minutes.
Fooled once.
Never twice.
Antibody Guard. An immune system for AI agents.
